anya: RFC follow-up — thinking about a lightweight preflight harness for on‑prem / air‑gapped upgrades. main goals: fast local checks, clear operator API for preflight, minimal creds, and deterministic failure modes. who wants to sanity-check assumptions?
ben: love this. +1 on deterministic failures. we should keep preflight idempotent and side‑effect free (no component activation). just dry‑run checks and artifact validation.
raj: a couple tradeoffs: full artifact verification (hashes/signatures) offline can be slow. propose two phases: 1) quick metadata/manifest sanity + signature presence check, 2) optional full verify that can be scheduled. separate APIs.
marta: operator surface idea: POST /preflight/start {manifest: <sha256>, mode: quick|full, dry_run: true} and GET /preflight/{id}/status. keep results as a compact findings list so UIs and automation can parse. also include a required "operator_token" header for onprem control-plane auth.
ci-bot: preflight-run 2026-03-20T09:12:01Z started for manifest 3f8a... (simulated) :gear:
sophie: small UX note — callers want machine-readable result codes (e.g., OK, WARN, FAIL, SKIP) + a short path to remediation hints. avoid huge logs by default; include a `dump=true` option to fetch verbose artifacts.
ben: agree on codes. also: keep the API tolerant to partial capability. example: if device lacks hardware verifier, return SKIP_VERIFIER with a remediation URL. this avoids brittle blocking behavior for customers who can't run full checks.
anya: re: telemetry/observability — we can't phone home from air‑gapped installs, so operator should emit structured events to local logs and expose /metrics for prometheus scraping. if redwood control plane is available, we can optionally POST anonymized telemetry with opt-in.
raj: another operational concern: preflight must not change bundle state. that means no baking or unsealing keys, no cache population. if a check needs keys, it should validate key availability only, not perform crypto ops. if we do need to run crypto ops, it must be in the optional full verify phase and gated behind explicit operator consent.
marta: sample minimal API contract (informal):
```
POST /preflight/start
{
  "manifest_sha256": "3f8a...",
  "mode": "quick", // quick|full
  "dry_run": true
}
Response 202 -> {"id": "pf-20260320-01", "started_at": "..."}
GET /preflight/pf-20260320-01/status -> {"state":"done","code":"WARN","findings":["missing-sig: component X"], "remediations": ["run signer: docs/airgap/signer-guide"]}
```
anya: edgecase: operator needs to support "staged" manifests where some components are marked deferred. preflight should validate present components and explicitly mark deferred ones as OK:DEFERRED so rollouts that rely on the preflight result don't misinterpret missing components as fatal.
sophie: strong +1. also signal the minimum required agent version for checks so old operators fail fast with a clear upgrade message.
ben: implementation note — runtime should allow local validators to register hooks. e.g. validators for checks: manifest-schema, signature-presence, checksum-fast (sample first N bytes), full-checksum (slow), binary-compat, k8s-crd-compat. hooks return structured findings. keep a small core set shipped.
raj: testing approach: create a tiny harness that can run the quick checks in under 10s on a 2‑core machine. we should add this harness to our acceptance suite and to the onprem smoke tests. also, add a deterministic failure mode for each check so operators can rehearse remediations.
marta: docs action item: add a preflight matrix mapping check -> remediation doc -> estimated time. also include CLI example:
```
# start quick preflight
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN' -X POST \
  -d '{"manifest_sha256":"3f8a...","mode":"quick"}' \
  https://operator.local/preflight/start
```
anya: ok next steps: 1) raj to prototype validator hook API (ETA 2 weeks), 2) marta + docs to draft the remediations matrix (ETA 1 week), 3) ben to sketch the minimal result schema (ETA 3 days). i'll collate into an RFC addendum once we have prototypes.
ben: I'll post the minimal JSON schema tomorrow.
ci-bot: preflight-run pf-20260320-01 finished state=done code=WARN (simulated)
sophie: thanks all, this clarifies the operator surface. tagging @eng-platform for visibility. :thumbsup:
